# PSLE Math heuristics pack for P6 (27 methods)

Web page: https://edge4exams.pages.dev/psle-math/

Most PSLE Math word problems can be solved with one of 27 methods. This pack teaches each one with a fully worked example and a bar model drawn to the exact numbers, then gives your child a practice question to try alone.

## Packs and prices

- **P6 Math Heuristics Pack: 27 Methods with Bar Models**: S$29, instant PDF. Buy: https://edge4examsg.gumroad.com/l/p6-math-heuristics

## What's in the pack

- 27 problem-solving heuristics, each with a fully worked PSLE-style example
- 14 bar models and diagrams, drawn to the exact numbers in each question
- "Spot it when" clue words, so your child knows which method to use
- The most common mistake for each method
- 27 practice questions with a full answer key

## Methods covered

- Models and before-after: part-whole, comparison, constant total, constant difference, constant part
- Fractions, ratio and percentage: equal fractions, remainder concept, repeated identity, equal stage, percentage change
- Number methods: excess and shortage, supposition, grouping, guess and check, working backwards
- Patterns, geometry and speed: systematic listing, patterns, overlapping areas, meeting and catching up, averages
- Advanced PSLE methods: units and parts, percentage transfer, simultaneous concept, number × value, supposition with a penalty, work rate, gap and difference

## PSLE Math questions parents ask

**Are these real PSLE questions?**

No. Every question is original and uses the problem-solving heuristics taught in Singapore primary schools. We never use real or copied exam papers.

**Who is it for?**

P6 students preparing for PSLE Math, and P5 students who are starting on word-problem heuristics.

**How should my child use it?**

One method a day for about four weeks: read the worked example together, cover the solution, let your child redo it alone, then try the practice question.

**How do I get the file?**

Checkout is on Gumroad. You get an instant PDF download you can print or use on a tablet.

# CMFAS M8 exam notes and mock exam (2026)

Web page: https://edge4exams.pages.dev/cmfas-m8/

M8 is the paper you need to advise on unit trusts and other collective investment schemes: 50 questions in 1 hour, and you need 70%. Fund parties, authorised vs recognised schemes and sales-charge sums catch out a lot of candidates.

## Packs and prices

- **CMFAS M8 Complete Pack**: S$34, instant PDF. Buy: https://edge4examsg.gumroad.com/l/m8
- **CM-CIS Bundle: M8 + M8A**: S$49, instant PDF. Buy: https://edge4examsg.gumroad.com/l/cmcis

## What's in the pack

- 11 pages of shortcut notes
- Calculation Decoder with 5 worked examples: NAV, sales charges, total return, dollar-cost averaging and the Sharpe ratio
- M8 Trap List: 20 wrong answers that look right
- Full 50-question mock exam in the real format, with answers and explanations
- One-page summary sheet

## Topics covered

- Investment basics, unit trusts and VCCs
- Fund manager vs trustee, and fund types
- ETFs and REITs
- The SFA and the Code on CIS
- Pricing, charges, CPFIS and advising clients

## CMFAS M8 questions people ask

**How many questions are in the CMFAS M8 exam?**

M8 has 50 multiple-choice questions in 1 hour, and the pass mark is 70%.

**What is CM-CIS?**

CM-CIS combines M8 and M8A. The CM-CIS Bundle gives you both complete packs, 100 practice questions in total, for less than buying them separately.

**Are these real exam questions?**

No. Every question is original and written in the style of the real exam. We never use leaked or copied exam content. Always read the official study text as well.

- One-page summary sheet

## Topics covered

- Structured funds, capital protection vs capital guarantee
- Forwards, futures, options, swaps and CDS
- Code on CIS derivative limits
- CPPI vs OBPI and hedge-fund strategies
- Leveraged, inverse and synthetic products, and suitability

**How many questions are in the CMFAS M8A exam?**

M8A has 50 multiple-choice questions in 1 hour, and the pass mark is 70%.

**Do I need M8 before M8A?**

Many candidates take them together as CM-CIS. The CM-CIS Bundle covers both papers with 100 practice questions.

Web page: https://edge4exams.pages.dev/cmfas-res5/

RES5 (Rules and Regulations for Financial Advisory Services) is one of the toughest CMFAS papers. You need 75% on Part I and 80% on Part II in the same sitting, or you resit everything. There are no calculation questions.

- One-page numbers sheet

## Topics covered

- The Financial Advisers Act (FAA) framework
- Representative rules, disclosure and recommendations
- Balanced scorecard and fair dealing
- FIDReC, AML/CFT and PDPA
- Market misconduct, ethics and skills

## CMFAS RES5 questions people ask

**What is the pass mark for CMFAS RES5?**

You need 75% on Part I and 80% on Part II, both in the same sitting.

**Do I need a calculator for RES5?**

No. RES5 has no calculation questions.

No. Every question is original and written in the style of the real exam. We never use leaked or copied exam content. Always read the official study text as well.

To deal in securities at a non-exchange member firm you need RES1B and CM-EIP. RES1B is 60 questions and needs 75%, so you can miss only 15. CM-EIP is 90 questions in 2.5 hours, and you need 63 right.

- RES1B: market misconduct offences, ethics and AML/CFT
- CM-EIP: equities, bonds and portfolio management
- CM-EIP: unit trusts, ETFs, REITs and FX, with calculations

## CMFAS RES1B and CM-EIP questions people ask

75%. You can miss at most 15 of the 60 questions.

90 questions in 2.5 hours. You need 63 correct to pass.

- Paper 1: mortgages, wills and intestacy, co-ownership and planning
- Paper 2: CEA rules, AML/CFT and marketing
- Paper 2: HDB resale and renting, BSD, ABSD, SSD and loan limits

Each paper is marked out of 100 and you need 60 to pass.

Yes. Paper 1 includes the new topics such as Land Betterment Charge, property torts and the Residential Property Act.
